title: StockSmart Demand Planning Note — Rising and Falling VendPoint Usage When a Consigned Bin Takes Over an Item
content:
When a new consigned bin under the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program takes over an item the customer has had taken out of one of its VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machines, the weekly usage behind the bin's fill-to level follows the item's trend in that machine.

**The months.** A row's age in whole months is the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month. The latest month holds rows of age zero, the middle month rows of age one and the earliest month rows of age two. Each month's figure is the item's net vends at the machine it was removed from at the customer's request: units vended there less units returned to that machine and units credited there as vend errors. The three-month figure is the total of the three months, and one third of it is that total divided by 3.

**Rule.**
- *Rising.* Where the item's net vends of the latest month exceed 1.25 times one third of its net vends of the last three months, its weekly usage is projected forward: its net vends of the latest month are first increased by half (0.5 times) of the rise from the earliest month to the latest month, and that projected month is then multiplied by 12 and divided by 52.
- *Falling.* Where its net vends of the latest month are below 0.75 times one third of its net vends of the last three months, its weekly usage is a weighted month: three times the latest month, twice the middle month and the earliest month are added together and the sum is divided by 6, and that weighted month is then multiplied by 12 and divided by 52.
- *Neither.* Any other item's weekly usage is not re-based under this note.

### Input, judgement, output (hypothetical months, in units)

| Earliest | Middle | Latest | Three-month total; one third | Judgement | Weekly usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 12 | 20 | 42; 14 | 20 exceeds 17.5 (1.25 times 14): rising | 20 plus 5 (half the rise of 10) is 25, times 12, divided by 52: 5.769231 |
| 20 | 12 | 6 | 38; 12.666667 | 6 is below 9.5 (0.75 times 12.666667): falling | 18 plus 24 plus 20 is 62, divided by 6 is 10.333333, times 12, divided by 52: 2.384615 |
| 10 | 11 | 15 | 36; 12 | 15 equals 15 (1.25 times 12) and does not exceed it | not re-based under this note |
| 14 | 13 | 9 | 36; 12 | 9 equals 9 (0.75 times 12) and is not below it | not re-based under this note |

The two thresholds are strict: equality with 1.25 times or with 0.75 times one third of the three-month figure triggers neither branch.
